tracks.title: [db] Roadmap-hub: migration (statusser, kendte fejl, admin-tal) - spor 1
tracks.scopeText: Udfoer 'Spor 1' i docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-04-roadmap-hub.md (laes ogsaa Global Constraints + Faelles kontrakt og spec'en docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-04-roadmap-hub-design.md §5). TDD: integrationstesten foerst, saa migrationen. Migrationen maa IKKE applies af dig; den applies post-merge af auto-migrate. Task 1.4 er orkestratorens. Migrationen daekker ogsaa del-punkt-RPCen og beta-koblingen (trigger paa app_config med fejl-fangst: et flag-flip maa ALDRIG kunne fejle pga. roadmappet). Roer aldrig en rigtig kontakt i prod.

tracks.title: [roadmap] Roadmap-hub: spillersiden i fem faner (Plan, Beta, Vote, Known issues, Done) - spor 2
tracks.scopeText: Udfoer 'Spor 2' i docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-04-roadmap-hub.md (laes ogsaa Global Constraints + Faelles kontrakt, spec'en §3 og §6, docs/design/PAGE_TEMPLATES.md, docs/design/TASTE.md og docs/TONE_OF_VOICE.md). Visuel reference: pr-screens/roadmap-4-10/roadmap-foer-efter.html, beta-overblik.html (Beta-fanen + stemmeskala i to trin) og known-issues-to-grupper.html (Known issues i to felter). Kod mod kolonnerne i Faelles kontrakt og brug preview-mocks; migrationen er maaske ikke applied endnu. Ingen patch note i PR'en. Draft-PR inden 30 min, push hvert 15. min.

tracks.title: [admin] Roadmap-hub: Roadmap-fane under /admin/growth (analyse + vedligehold) - spor 3
tracks.scopeText: Udfoer 'Spor 3' i docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-04-roadmap-hub.md (laes ogsaa Global Constraints + Faelles kontrakt og spec'en §4). Visuel reference: feltet 'Bagved' i pr-screens/roadmap-4-10/roadmap-foer-efter.html. roadmapModel.ts ejes af spor 2: findes den ikke i dit worktree, deklarer de fire typer lokalt i roadmapAdminModel.ts. Dansk admin-tekst. Ingen patch note i PR'en.

tracks.title: [ops] Roadmap-hub: faerdig-rutine (roadmap-flip.mjs + close-protokol) - spor 4
tracks.scopeText: Udfoer 'Spor 4' i docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-04-roadmap-hub.md (laes ogsaa Global Constraints + Faelles kontrakt og spec'en §7). Scriptet maa ALDRIG koeres med --apply af dig, og du maa ikke printe secrets (hard rule om secret-leaks i AGENTS.md). Spor 4 omfatter ogsaa Task 4.3 (roadmap-drift.mjs, read-only tjek mod MASTERPLAN).

tracks.title: [patch-notes] Roadmap-hub: beta-filter og maerke der foelger kontakten - spor 5
tracks.scopeText: Udfoer 'Spor 5' i docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-04-roadmap-hub.md (laes ogsaa Global Constraints og spec'en §6b, docs/PATCH_NOTES_RULES.md, docs/TONE_OF_VOICE.md). Visuel reference: feltet 'Patch notes' i pr-screens/roadmap-4-10/beta-overblik.html. Roer ingen patch note-TEKST; kun feltet flag. Ingen patch note i PR'en.
